headline: Crusoe Cloud is the customer at Polar's DRA01 in Tørdal, Norway, live 21 Oct 2026 at 12MW
detail: Crusoe Cloud is the customer at Polar's DRA01 (Tørdal, Norway), live 2026-10-21 with 12MW; DRA02 (~40MW) planned late 2027.
note: Recovered from the atlas the Routine published on 2026-10-26; the run's own signals file was never pushed. Other signals from that run, if any, are not recoverable.
